description: This file manages tax configuration in the vtiger CRM, including viewing, editing, adding, enabling/disabling, and updating tax labels and percentages for both inventory and shipping taxes.

methods.name: updateTaxPercentages
methods.description: Updates the list of tax percentages for specified tax types, optionally for shipping and handling.

methods.name: updateTaxLabels
methods.description: Updates the labels of specified taxes, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: addTaxType
methods.description: Adds a new tax type, creating database entries and altering related tables.

methods.name: changeDeleted
methods.description: Enables or disables a tax type by updating its 'deleted' status.
